record.enforcement: GDI confirms goods prohibition June 29, 2025. Hun Sen reiterates the closed-land-border goods prohibition June 13, 2026 while acknowledging Thai merchandise circulating in Cambodia. This is later official policy testimony, not independent proof of continuous enforcement.
record.status_observation: Latest adopted policy assertion dated 2026-06-13; actual continuity and universal implementation not established.
record.official_rationale: Reciprocal response to Thai closure; restoration made conditional on Thai reopening.
record.uncertainty: Confirmed inforce June 29; precise introduction date and endpoint not established. Opposite-side policy overlay on EA001, not an independent physical border interval. Round11 found no direct support for an Elite politics mechanism; that code is removed. July16 selected-commodity import rules do not establish land-gate reopening. GDI announcement repeated by AKP and CamboJA is one policy lineage; nationwide implementation is not independently observed. Round14 targeted scope/continuity follow-up adds June 13, 2026 official assertion only; the roughly one-year wording is not adopted as an exact or uninterrupted physical closure duration.
